behavior.arguments: rdi = the single 64-bit input. No other input register is read; rsi, rdx, rcx, and r8 are all overwritten inside the window before use.

edges.clamp_boundary: rdi = 32 gives doubled value 63, bsr 5, shift 4, masked field 1, clamped index 6, result 1 + 24 - 23 = 2: the last input where the index floor binds.
edges.clamp_release: rdi = 33 gives doubled value 65, bsr 6, shift 4, masked field 2, clamped index 6, result 2 + 24 - 23 = 3: the first input where the raw bsr reaches the floor.
edges.one_input: rdi = 1 gives doubled value 1, bsr 0, shift 4, masked field 0, clamped index 6, result 0 + 24 - 23 = 1.
edges.shift_step: rdi = 65 gives doubled value 129, bsr 7, shift 4, masked field 0, clamped index 7, result 0 + 28 - 23 = 5.
edges.top_bit: rdi = 2^63 gives doubled value 2^64 - 1, bsr 63, shift 60, masked field 3, clamped index 63, result 3 + 252 - 23 = 232.
edges.zero_input: rdi = 0 gives doubled value 2^64 - 1 (all ones), bsr 63, shift 60, masked field 3, clamped index 63, result 3 + 252 - 23 = 232. The doubled value is always odd, so the bsr input is never zero and the rule is defined for every 64-bit input.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with lea (NOT endbr64); zero branches (cmov only); a single ret; no calls inside.
behavior.return_rule: Returns eax = masked + 4 * clamped - 0x17, where bsr = bsr(2*rdi - 1), shift = max(7, bsr) - 3, masked = (((rdi - 1) & (-1 << shift)) >> shift) & 3, and clamped = max(bsr, 6). All arithmetic wraps at 64 bits except the final eax, which wraps at 32 bits. No field is written.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; two sites found in two distinct caller FDEs, each confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
